title: Observer Pattern Recipe — Companion Resources
description: Runnable observer pattern implementations: a basic order event emitter (TypeScript), a typed emitter with error isolation (TypeScript), a debounced emitter for high-frequency events (TypeScript), a WeakRef-based observer with automatic cleanup (TypeScript), PropertyChangeSupport observers (Java) and reactive streams (Python/RxPY).
description_es: Implementaciones ejecutables del observer pattern: event emitter básico de pedidos (TypeScript), emitter tipado con aislamiento de errores (TypeScript), emitter con debounce para eventos de alta frecuencia (TypeScript), observer con WeakRef y limpieza automática (TypeScript), observers con PropertyChangeSupport (Java) y reactive streams (Python/RxPY).
